'''Milam Harnder''' is the Second Librarian in the Royal Palace library in [[Caemlyn]].

==Appearance==
Master Harnder is described as a bald man with a round face.{{ref/book|6|46}}

==History==
He has been an [[Eyes-and-ears|agent]] of [[Demira Eriff]] for nearly thirty years. [[Reene Harfor]] discovers that he is also and agent for the [[Brown Ajah]].{{ref/book|10|13}}

==Activities==
Demira Eriff was set to meet Master Harnder at the Origan Gate in the Inner City of Caemlyn, but never arrived. He also visits an inn called the [[Hoop and Arrow]] every few days. After each of his visits, a pigeon flies north, presumably to the [[White Tower]].{{ref/book|10|14}}
